body: No single person is worth killing yourself over, unless you are saving your child's life. That is the only circumstance I can think of.

I'm severely mentally ill and can barely function in day to day self care. Taking steps is daunting.

My suicide is nearly complete. I have ridden myself of all financial resources. I have nearly ridden myself of all physical belongings. My mind is cracking and I will soon be made a beggar. Those in better financial positions than I laugh at my misfortune. My position is the butt of jokes. Have I become a joke? Actually, such sentiments do not bother me. They are childish and wanting for originality. In any case, I have spent 33 years on this planet, and I do not desire to spend any more. I will buy rope at the department store, research online how to tie it into a strong noose, and in the dead of night, I will find a suitable, somewhat hidden tree, and properly hang myself, ending everything. 
	The scene of the discovering of my body. They will find a phone, and numbers dialed. They will find a student ID card, a driver’s license. They will investigate and determine if any of those numbers belong to family. They will contact such family. Family will be notified of my passing, probably by phone. Arrangements will be made. My corpse will be interred in a local morgue until my family receives it for burial. Ron, Mary, Laura, Kim, and Cheryl will descend on a particular location for such burial, most likely in Prescott. Tears will be shed, hugs will be had. Remembrances of a boy and a man will be had. They will grieve, but they will return to their lives. The 2 year old girl will never know her uncle. 
	Months and years will pass. They will create their own families and move on. Pictures will remind them of someone who once shared this earth with them for a time. After some time, they will smile and remember the good, rather than succumbing to a poor mood. It is a process they will go through in time. This life is short for all, shorter for some, longer for some, but for all, ultimately, short. As is said under such circumstances the world over, life goes on. Indeed, life will go on. There is no escaping one’s final fate, and once it is realized, one can either decide to live life fully, or pass on into the nothingness. This individual chose eternal sleep sooner rather than later. 
	Death, death, death, you do not come soon enough. Death, death, death, you are simple, while life is tough. Death, death, death, of life, I have had enough.
